rundown: Hurricanes beat Kraken 5-1 at Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki in front of 12,813. Hurricanes led 4-1 after two periods and never looked back. The 1st period decided it: Hurricanes won it 2-0.
6 goals in all. Hurricanes's last: Mark Jankowski Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Taylor Hall (4), Seth Jarvis (7), 3rd period 11:06.
Leading the way — Kraken: Matty Beniers 1 goal, 1 pts; Jordan Eberle 1 ast. Hurricanes: Mark Jankowski 2 goals; Nikolaj Ehlers 3 ast, 3 pts.
Where Hurricanes won it: they outshot them 36-14 and scored 3 on the power play to 0.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Hurricanes closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 2.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 6, under by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 12:59 PM ET. It had Kraken 34% and Hurricanes 66%, projecting Kraken 2.6 – Hurricanes 3.6 (6.2 total, Hurricanes by 1).

Final: Kraken 1 – Hurricanes 5. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 66%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Kraken came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (9-7-1, 3.4 scored and 3.6 allowed a game over 17 games), worth about 76 and 76 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.6, they scored 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under); projected to allow 3.6, they allowed 5 (+1.4 goals, 40% over).

Hurricanes came in with a 12% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (15-3-2, 4.1 scored and 2.3 allowed a game over 20 games), worth about 78 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.6, they scored 5 (+1.4 goals, 40% over); projected to allow 2.6, they allowed 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under).

The bigger miss was Kraken's scoring (-1.6 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 6 against 6.2 projected (-0.2), about the 47th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Hurricanes by 4 against Hurricanes by 1 projected, about the 89th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
CAR ML (-395) at -395: the algo gave it 76% vs 77% fair (-1 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 76%). SEA ML (+310) at +310: the algo gave it 24% vs 23% fair (+1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 24%). CAR -1.5 (-155) at -155: the algo gave it 56% vs 58% fair (-1.9 pts) — won (+0.6u); same number as the close. SEA +1.5 (+130) at +130: the algo gave it 44% vs 42% fair (+1.9 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (+102) at +102: the algo gave it 47% vs 47% fair (-0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-122) at -122: the algo gave it 53% vs 53% fair (+0.3 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 3% of bets on Kraken, 4% of the money — Hurricanes covered; total: 87% of bets on the over, 94% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 3% of bets on Kraken, 4% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.932 of the raw projection. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 67 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.953 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Kraken attack ×0.960, defense ×1.011 (4 games); Hurricanes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 3 goals), the pick lost (-1u).
